summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new 'Verify & Promote™' tab on the Refinement Initiative page. All acceptance criteria pass. Honesty invariant is visibly enforced in the UI (negative path stays internal). Positive path on a fresh KR promotes to Verified External™, cascades 6 products → Gold, and appends an immutable lineage entry (v1→v2). Re-promoting an already-promoted KR correctly shows Promoted-to-Gold=0 (delta, not total) while cascade product list still displays 'Gold' — expected behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: Refinement.js verifyPromote(): the sources state is initialised from data.attached_sources on KR select. For an already-promoted KR, this pre-populates approved sources. Behaviour is correct but reviewers should be aware promoted-to-gold delta will be 0 on subsequent submits — the cascade product list still visually reflects Gold, which is the source of truth.

promote-source-* data-testids are index-based across all claims (flat index), which is fine, but could become confusing if a claim is removed and a new one added — consider (claim_id, source_index) composite testid for future-proofing.
The 'Verified External' StatusChip in the KR list uses the derived flag evidence_sufficient_for_external_publication; the KR item shows this correctly after promotion (v1→v2).
No a11y regression observed: checkboxes have labels, submit button has disabled state during promotion.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Refinement Era iteration 54. Verify & Promote frontend flow is fully functional end-to-end. Honesty invariant is visibly enforced. If retesting, note that many KRs from previous benchmark runs are already promoted — pick a KR whose status chip reads 'Internal · needs sources' for a clean positive-path with promoted_to_gold>0. Prior /api/flow/registry issue from iteration_53 is unrelated to this feature.
